parts.text: 现在完成时表示动作现存的结果，或者过去发生的事对现在的影响，通常发生的时间不明（如果出现了具体的时间，会使用“一般过去时”）。 结构：have/has + done（v. 过去分词） 用法： 完成？ 现在的之前 做没做完并不重要，重要的是站在哪个角度去看。现在完成时是站在现在的这个角度往之前看。现在完成时表示动作现存的结果，或者过去发生的事对现在的影响。 常与现在完成时连用的 副词 和 副词短语 疑问句 和 否定句 中

rows: He has finished the homework.
We have learned English for ten years.
He has finished the homework.
I have finished the work.
He has not finished the homework.(hasn't)
I have not finished the work.(haven't)
Has he finished the homework?
Have you finished the work?
What has he done ?
What have you done ?
I have never been to Paris before.（我以前从未去过巴黎。）
It's the first time I've tried sushi.（这是我第一次尝试寿司。）
So far, I have finished three books this month.（到目前为止，我这个月已经读完了三本书。）
I have received three emails so far this morning.（到今天早上为止，我今天上午已经收到了三封邮件。）
Up to now, I haven't received any updates on the project.（直到现在，我还没有收到关于项目的任何更新。）
Up to the present, she has published ten research papers.（直到现在，她已经发表了十篇研究论文。）
I have just finished my homework.（我刚做完作业。）
Have you seen her recently?（你最近见过她吗？）
He has already eaten dinner.（他已经吃过晚饭了。）
Lately, I've been feeling tired all the time.（最近，我一直感觉很累。）
I have had a meeting now.（我现在已有一个会议。）
I have been learning Spanish for two years.（我已经学习西班牙语两年了。）
She has been working here since 2010.（她自2010年以来一直在这里工作。）
The store is open till 9 PM.（商店一直开放到晚上9点。）
I have found my keys at last.（我终于找到了我的钥匙。）
He has finally finished his thesis.（他终于完成了他的论文。）
Have you ever been to Paris?（你曾经去过巴黎吗？）
Have you finished your homework yet?（你完成作业了吗？）
I have never seen a shooting star.（我从来没有见过流星。）
He does not ever eat spicy food.（他从不吃辣食。）
Have you ever been skydiving?（你曾经体验过跳伞吗？）
He is yet to finish his project.（他尚未完成他的项目。）
I will never again trust him.（我再也不会信任他。）
I have not yet received the package.（我还没有收到包裹。）
I have been happy ever since I met you.（自从遇见你之后，我一直很幸福。）
This has never happened before.（这从未发生过。）
He doesn't work / live here anymore.（他不再在这里工作了/不再住这里了。）
I can't leave just yet.（我还不能离开。）
I will love you evermore.（我将永远爱你。）
Never mind, it's not important.（没关系，这不重要。）
I have yet to meet my new neighbor.（我还没见过我的新邻居。）

parts.text: I’ve planted fourteen rose bushes so far this morning. 到今天上午为止，我已经种了十四丛玫瑰。
I have lived here for several years now and I’ve made many new friends since I have lived here. 我已经在这里住了好几年了，自从我住在这里以来，我交了很多新朋友。
现在完成时还可和表示频度的副词连用，表示反复和习惯性动作。

rows: I often go for a walk in the park.（我经常在公园散步。）
She frequently travels for work.（她经常出差。）
I have visited that museum three times.（我去过那个博物馆三次。）
He comes to visit us quite often.（他相当频繁地来看我们。）
They meet regularly for coffee on Fridays.（他们每周五定期见面喝咖啡。）
The child kept asking the same question repeatedly.（孩子一再询问同一个问题。）
She goes for a run daily.（她每天都去跑步。）
Oftentimes, people judge others based on appearance.（往往人们会根据外貌来评判他人。）
Sometimes, I like to relax and watch movies.（有时候，我喜欢放松看电影。）
We go out for dinner occasionally.（我们偶尔出去吃饭。）
He seldom goes to parties.（他很少去参加派对。）
I rarely eat fast food.（我很少吃快餐。）
Once in a while, we treat ourselves to a spa day.（偶尔，我们会给自己放松一天。）
They go on vacations every now and then.（他们时不时会去度假。）
